Bahrain
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Abu Dhabi, U. A. E.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens:
Regular passport YES - Visa shall be issued in Bonn
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Kingdom of Bahrain need a visa when entering, exiting or crossing the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina. The visa is issued at the Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Abu Dhabi.
NOTE:
In accordance with the Decision of the Council of Ministers of Bosnia and Herzegovina dated April 15, 2026, amending the Decision on Visas, citizens of the Kingdom of Bahrain holding ordinary passports are exempt from the obligation to obtain a visa for entry, exit, transit, and stay in the territory of Bosnia and Herzegovina for the period from June 1, 2026 to September 30, 2026.
The total duration of stay for citizens of the Kingdom of Bahrain in Bosnia and Herzegovina within the specified period is up to 60 days.
The stay of citizens of the Kingdom of Bahrain in Bosnia and Herzegovina under the aforementioned visa-free regime is permitted until September 30, 2026. For stays in Bosnia and Herzegovina after September 30, 2026, a visa is required.
Travel advisory: There is a travel risk in certain areas. It is necessary to obtain more detailed information before traveling.
Security conditions: Taking into account the security and general situation, and for the safety of our citizens, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina recommends that all citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina avoid travel.
In the event of changes in the security situation, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs will provide timely notifications to citizens of Bosnia and Herzegovina in an appropriate manner.
Health conditions: Good.
Drug penalties: Range from high fines and prison sentences to the death penalty.
Consumption of alcohol and pork is permitted.
Photographing women and police is prohibited. The use of video cameras may cause certain problems.
Special note for travelers: It is necessary to have a passport valid for the next 18 months, and passengers with entry and exit visas for Israel will not be allowed to enter Bahrain.
Dialing code: ++973
